patches.name: Debug search logging
patches.description: Temporary diagnostic patch: logs search responses and failures to logcat.

patches.name: Enable search landing recommendations
patches.description: Turns on the "You may like" trending panel on the search landing screen.

patches.name: Fix TikTok TV identity
patches.description: Re-tags the search and profile requests with the TikTok TV app id, which those backends require, while the feed keeps the TikTok Lite id that it is only served under; empty risk-engine answers are retried.

patches.name: Fix TikTok TV profiles
patches.description: Sends profile-head and video-grid requests to the live TikTok Lite endpoints instead of the retired TV profile backend.

patches.name: Nested comment replies
patches.description: Shows a comment's reply count in the row and opens its replies in a SmartTube-style sub-pane on CENTER, with BACK returning to the comment list. Fully D-pad operable.

patches.name: Play in background
patches.description: Adds a More-pane Off / Only audio choice that keeps the current post playing when the TV app is backgrounded.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Adds 2x, 1.5x, 1x and 0.5x playback to the player's More pane, applied with the same TTVideoEngine.setPlaybackParams call TikTok Lite uses.

patches.name: Remove TV sidebar categories
patches.description: Empties the TV category lists so the sidebar only shows Search, For You, and Following, like TikTok Lite.

patches.name: Remove feed ads
patches.description: Drops the ad posts TikTok Lite puts in the feed, search, category and profile responses, which the TV app otherwise plays as ordinary videos.

patches.name: Render Lite image posts
patches.description: Shows the pictures of a TikTok Lite image post instead of a black player, which the TV app cannot render at all.

patches.name: Render Lite subtitles
patches.description: Adds the subtitles button to the player's floating row and draws the post's captions over the video, with SmartTube-style presets, size and position settings in the More pane.

patches.name: Show TikTok Lite content
patches.description: Reports the TikTok Lite app id on the wire and targets the live feed endpoint, so the server serves TikTok content instead of the retired TV feed.

options.description: The app id sent in the signed common parameters. TikTok Lite is 1340.
The app name sent in the signed common parameters. TikTok Lite is musically_go.
The live endpoint the retired TV feed path is rewritten to. Lite's personalized For You feed is /lite/v2/feed/fyp/; /aweme/v1/feed/ is the mobile fallback.

patches.name: Translate comments and captions
patches.description: Adds TikTok's Aa translation panel to More — always translate comments, a do-not-translate list, the target language and also-translate-caption — and renders a dimmed "Translated from …" line under translated comments and above translated captions.
